title: Introduce RAG Authoring Lightbox quickstart with live-edit & telemetry probes
author: Marisol Chen
description: Adds a compact, local-first 'RAG Authoring Lightbox' quickstart intended for fast iteration when building retrieval-augmented agents. Motivation: teams want an ultra-light playground that bundles an embedded snippet editor, incremental indexer, schema-driven tool contract linter, and low-friction telemetry probes to speed up authoring and regression testing without pulling full dev infra. This PR delivers: 1) quickstarts/rag-authoring-lightbox with step-by-step README and a small devcontainer for one-command onboarding; 2) a lightweight live-edit web UI (static + node dev server) that shows request/response deltas and lets authors replay sessions; 3) an incremental minibatch indexer (local FS-backed) with seeded sample corpus and a small CLI for adding snapshots; 4) a compact telemetry probes config with example traces and quick dashboard links; 5) contract linter for tool schemas and example policies to run during watch mode; 6) test harness with two smoke scenarios that run in CI (headless) and locally. Checklist: - [x] README and quickstart guide - [x] devcontainer + Dockerfile for local dev - [x] live-edit UI + server - [x] incremental indexer + seed scripts - [x] telemetry probes with sample dashboards - [x] contract linter + example rules - [x] CI job added to quickstarts smoke pipeline - [x] examples and snippet gallery integrated into docs site Notes on usage: clone repo, cd quickstarts/rag-authoring-lightbox, ./dev up to open the live editor; run ./indexer seed to load sample docs; run yarn test:smoke to exercise CI scenarios. Backwards compatibility: this is an additive quickstart; no platform code changes. Known limitations: the embedded indexer is not for production scale; telemetry uses short retention and synthetic traces by default. Related: ENG-4521 (authoring toolkit), PM-1189 (quickstart roadmap).
